mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.role_name, r.role_code, r.description, r.status, r.sort, r.create_id, r.create_name, r.create_time, r.update_id, r.update_name, r.update_time, r.deleted, r.delete_id, r.delete_name, r.delete_time FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.sort ASC

SELECT r.id, r.role_name, r.role_code, r.description, r.status, r.sort, r.create_id, r.create_name, r.create_time, r.update_id, r.update_name, r.update_time, r.deleted, r.delete_id, r.delete_name, r.delete_time FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.sort ASC, r.id ASC

SELECT r.id, r.role_name, r.role_code, r.description, r.status, r.sort, r.create_id, r.create_name, r.create_time, r.update_id, r.update_name, r.update_time, r.deleted, r.delete_id, r.delete_name, r.delete_time FROM sys_role r
r.deleted = 0
AND r.role_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{roleName}, '%')
AND r.role_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{roleCode}, '%')
ORDER BY r.sort ASC, r.id ASC

SELECT r.id, r.role_name, r.role_code, r.description, r.status, r.sort, r.create_id, r.create_name, r.create_time, r.update_id, r.update_name, r.update_time, r.deleted, r.delete_id, r.delete_name, r.delete_time FROM sys_role r WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.sort ASC, r.id ASC
SELECT rp.permission_id FROM sys_role_permission rp INNER JOIN sys_permission p ON rp.permission_id = p.id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} AND p.deleted = 0
